content: Kriti Mahajan reached out to insurance agent Anita Sharma to confirm that her auto policy is active after paying a $150 overdue premium. Anita confirmed the policy is active and explained it had expired due to a missed payment despite prior reminders. Kriti expressed gratitude and mentioned she will set up automatic payments to avoid future issues.

action_items: Customer will receive an email with updated policy documents
Customer plans to set up auto pay
